description: Resume a budget that was paused by anomaly detection or manually. A budget is paused when a spend request is statistically unusual (autoPauseOnAnomaly=true) or via PATCH /budgets/{id}. A human must review and provide an override reason before the budget can be used again. Requires override_reason explaining why the pause was reviewed and cleared.

override_by.description: Optional identifier for the operator or system performing the override (e.g. 'ops-team', 'user_456').

override_reason.description: Required explanation for why the budget is being resumed (e.g. 'Reviewed — legitimate bulk purchase approved by ops team').

name: figuard_resume_budget
